model.name: MiniMax H3 VDN 8-Step 33B
model.description: MiniMax H3 FL2VA with trained VDN hybrid window/linear attention for faster long-video generation. Triton is required for optimal performance. The VDN 8-step acceleration LoRA is automatically loaded.
model.infos:
### Automatic 8-step acceleration
The VDN 8-step acceleration LoRA is automatically loaded and generation defaults to 8 steps.

prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A continuous cinematic tracking shot races alongside a vintage red convertible crossing a vast desert at golden hour. The camera begins close to the spinning front wheel, rises past the driver, then sweeps outward as the car enters a field of towering wind turbines. Dust streams behind the tires, warm sunlight flashes across the chrome, and distant storm clouds gather while the road curves toward the horizon.
overall_soundscape: The steady growl of the engine, tires humming over asphalt, rushing wind, faint radio music from inside the car, and a distant roll of thunder near the end.
